_comment: Production options for newapi.woowtech.io; staging applies the same file, then deploy/settings-stg.json. Accounts come from the PaaS only, so every self-service sign-up path and free-credit path is off (GHSA-8r8v: free seed balance made the billing overflow exploitable at scale). Change options here, never only in the console: get-options --snapshot (outside this repo) -> apply-settings -> verify-settings (docs/OPERATIONS.md). A price change (GroupRatio here, model ratios in deploy/pricing/pricing-plan.json) goes through this repo too, followed by verify-settings.
_comment_paas: The PaaS AI-models tab depends on GroupRatio, UserUsableGroups, GroupGroupRatio, group_ratio_setting.group_special_usable_group, quota_setting.*, ModelRequestRateLimit*, RegisterEnabled, QuotaFor*, checkin_setting.enabled, LogConsumeEnabled, DataExportEnabled, SelfUseModeEnabled, HeaderNavModules, ExposeRatioEnabled and general_setting.quota_display_type / custom_currency_exchange_rate, and stops provisioning, keys and conversions when they drift. Tell the PaaS side before changing one (docs/OPERATIONS.md, invariants in scripts/newapi_admin.py).
_comment_groups: default = sellable models at markup 1.3 (D5); free = self-hosted Qwen3-4B trial, ratio 0 (D11): with quota_setting.enable_free_model_pre_consume false, accounts that never converted points can use it, so no group other than free may have ratio 0, group free may serve only the two Qwen (deploy/pricing/channels.json), and no model in a paid group may have ModelRatio 0 (rc.44 bills that as free for everyone too; build_pricing.py leaves such models out). internal = ChatGPT-subscription test channel, NOT user-selectable. group_special_usable_group holds only '-:' removals (an add would open a group to a user group): free_blocked -> -:free is preset for the LLM-10 trial fallback, which then only moves a user into group free_blocked (no user is in it otherwise, so it does nothing). Model ratios = LiteLLM cost. Never read or write group_ratio_setting.group_ratio / group_group_ratio: on rc.44 they are start-up exports of the built-in defaults that do not follow GroupRatio / GroupGroupRatio, yet a PUT of one replaces the live group ratios (newapi_admin.py refuses both). What counts is the effective ratio in GET /api/pricing group_ratio.
_comment_nav: Rankings is public without login and lists every model's usage, internal ones included; keep it off (backend /api/rankings then returns 403).
_comment_ratelimit: rc.44 safe combination: groups share one counter key and only swap the limit (middleware/model-rate-limit.go:195-199), so paid requests could refill the free bucket (541 free requests/min in simulation). Hence the global Count stays 0 (groups without an override never touch the total bucket), only free is overridden, and free[1] == the global SuccessCount (one shared success list: paid + free 120 successes/min). free[0] = 10 is the D11 per-minute trial cap (an invariant: the PaaS copy and terms say 10); the daily cap (200) is enforced by the PaaS meter cron. After upgrading to a release with 45fbb149f (per-group counters), once the contract test sees Redis keys rateLimit:<uid>:free: ModelRequestRateLimitGroup {"default": [300, 120], "free": [10, 10]}, global Count 0 and SuccessCount 120. Those values break the rc.44 invariants on purpose: the same PR bumps INVARIANTS_FOR_VERSION and rewrites the rate-limit-group and rate-limit-count invariants and their test (test_upgrade_values_fail_on_rc44), and the PaaS I8 list changes with it (docs/OPERATIONS.md, 升版).
